was identified as todd clark. he told me he was stopped about one car length behind a silver lexus suv who was stopped at the stop [roadway] [roadway]. clark said the suv started to pull forward when the girl on a motorized scooter came flying and ran into the side of the suv, i asked him if the girl came from the driveway ([roadway]) from world of tennis, he said, ""yes."" clark said he saw the girl buckle and go under the car, he didn't know if she ended up under the tire. clark and his wife grace, stopped, and assisted at the scene. the suv involved in the collision is a silver 2016 lexus [identifier] with texas license plate [identifier]. i looked at the lexus and noticed a large dent in the right front fender. the other driver who [roadway] next to the suv was identified as nancy shilling. shilling commented that she saw the suv hit the girl, i told her that the girl actually ran into the side of the suv. shilling didn't see where the girl came from. the driver of the suv was identified by a texas driver's license as ningguang xu. i asked ningguang if he saw where the girl came from, he said he has no idea. he said he stopped and then pressed the gas pedal and was then hit (by the scooter). ningguang told me he has a dashcam, he was unable to show me the video and said he needed to get the memory card and upload the video. i gave him my business card and asked him to email me the video. the girl on the scooter was identified as 12-year-old charlotte seif. her dad arrived on scene, he was identified as alexander seif. charlotte told me she was coming back from lakeway market and was riding on the westbound sidewalk and was going to [roadway] [roadway]. she said she was trying to stop and then, from what she remembers is just crossing right into him. i asked her if she stopped at the crosswalk, she said she stopped for a second and the car wasn't going. i asked her if she was coming down the driveway from world of tennis, she said she did not come down the driveway and that she was on the sidewalk. looking at the amount of damage to the suv, i don't believe she stopped at the crosswalk. alexander stated those scooters have some ""serious pick-up"",
